# Copilot Instructions

## Objective
Create a personal portfolio website for COMP 2068 Assignment 1 using Express.js and the Handlebars templating engine.

## Assignment Rules
- Use the Express Generator project structure.
- Use HBS as the templating engine.
- Use only one router file: routes/index.js.
- Create four pages: Home, About Me, Projects, and Contact Me.
- Each page must be a separate view file.
- Use layout.hbs for the shared header, footer, CSS links, Bootstrap links, and overall website layout.
- Footer must include GitHub and LinkedIn links.
- Keep all views inside the views folder.
- Keep all routers/controllers inside the routes folder.
- Include README documentation.
- Deploy the website to a cloud hosting service.

## Personal Brand
Use a soft pink, cream, and complementary colour scheme. The website should look friendly, clean, professional, and student-focused.
